Messages.Body:
What would happen if I a vampire with slaughtering the herd, 0 blood and
then hunts?

Macro Wong

Messages.Author: Miller Delmardigan
Messages.Body:
"Marco Wong" <h99x...@hkusua.hku.hk> a écrit dans le message de news:
arvo66$oa...@hkunae.hku.hk...


Card text :
Slaughtering the Herd [Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Action

Cost: 2 blood

Discipline: Dominate

[dom] (D) Bleed at +2 bleed. Allies cannot block this action.
[DOM] (D) Put this card on a vampire controlled by your predator. Each time
that vampire takes an action, he or she moves 1 blood to this acting vampire
when the action is announced. That vampire may burn this card by burning 4
blood during his or her controller's minion phase. Burn this card if this
acting vampire is sent to torpor or burned.

IMHO, the Vampire will hunt anyway, failing to move a blood from him to the
Vampire that put this card on him.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Miller Delmardigan wrote:
> "Marco Wong" <h99x...@hkusua.hku.hk> a écrit dans le message de news:

> > What would happen if I a vampire with slaughtering the herd, 0 blood and
> > then hunts?

> IMHO, the Vampire will hunt anyway, failing to move a blood from him to the
> Vampire that put this card on him.

Correct.
He takes the hunt action, fails to move a blood.
Then, if the action succeeds, he gains a blood.
If the action is blocked, he goes to combat.
